---
title: "Isochrones"
format: html
editor: visual
---

An **isochrone** is a line or polygon on a map that connects all points reachable from a specific starting location within a set amount of time

[Inspiration from Kyle Walker](https://walker-data.com/posts/accessibility-surface/)

### Libraries

```{r}
library(mapboxapi)
library(leaflet)
library(mapview)
```

### Create Isochrone

```{r}
isos <- mb_isochrone(
  location = "One Bowerman Dr, Beaverton, OR 97005",
  profile = "driving",
  time = 1:45
)
```

```{r}
mapview(isos, zcol = "time")
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(fasterize)

isos_proj <- st_transform(isos, 32618)

template <- raster(isos_proj, resolution = 100)

iso_surface <- fasterize(isos_proj, template, field = "time", fun = "min")

iso_surface
pal <- colorNumeric("plasma", isos$time, na.color = "transparent")

nike_map <- leaflet() %>%
  addMapboxTiles(style_id = "light-v9",
                 username = "mapbox",
                 scaling_factor = "0.5x") %>%
  addRasterImage(iso_surface, colors = pal, opacity = 0.5) %>%
  addLegend(values = isos$time, pal = pal,
            title = "Drive-time from<br>Nike HQ")

nike_map
```

```{r}
nike_icon <- makeIcon(
  iconUrl = "https://nike.com/favicon.ico",
  iconWidth = 25,
  iconHeight = 25
)

nike_hq <- mb_geocode("One Bowerman Dr, Beaverton, OR 97005")

nike_map %>%
  addMarkers(lng = nike_hq[1], lat = nike_hq[2], icon = nike_icon)
```

### Recreate for Chaminade

Scenario: During a Hurricane/bad storm, how long does it take for first-responders to get to their locations and to the hospitals? What affect do traffic time zones and flood elevation lines have on drive time?

```{r}
campus <- mb_geocode(
  "3140 Waialae Avenue, Honolulu, HI 96816",
  output = "sf"
)

campus <- st_transform(campus, 4326)
```

```{r}
mapview(campus)
```

```{r}
travel_times <- c(5, 10, 15, 30, 45)
isos <- mb_isochrone(
  location = campus,
  profile = "driving",
  time = travel_times)
isos <- st_transform(st_make_valid(isos), 4326)
```

```{r}
taz <- st_read(
  "data/Traffic_Analysis_Zones_(TAZ)_-_Oahu.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE)

hospitals <- st_read(
  "data/Hospitals.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE)

flood_lines <- st_read(
  "data/flood_elevation_lines.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE)

taz <- st_transform(st_make_valid(taz), 4326)
hospitals <- st_transform(hospitals, 4326)
flood_lines <- st_transform(
  st_make_valid(flood_lines),
  4326)
```

These are the Geojson files I downloaded from opendata.hawaii.gov and geoportal.hawaii.gov that hold data on traffic zones, flood elevation lines, and hospitals located in Hawaii.

```{r}
oahu_area <- st_union(taz)
hospitals <- hospitals[
  lengths(st_intersects(hospitals, oahu_area)) > 0,]
flood_lines <- st_intersection(
  flood_lines,
  oahu_area)

isos_oahu <- st_intersection(
  isos,
  oahu_area)

isos_oahu <- isos_oahu[
  order(isos_oahu$time, decreasing = TRUE),]
```

I then narrowed the data down to list only on the island of 'Oahu and made larger zones before I made the smaller ones.

```{r}
hospitals$popup <- paste0(
  "<b>", hospitals$name, "</b>",
  "<br>Type: ", hospitals$facilitytype_name,
  "<br>Address: ", hospitals$address_addressline1,
  "<br>City: ", hospitals$address_addresscity,
  "<br>Phone: ", hospitals$contact_businessprimaryphone)
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = travel_times)
```

```{r}
hospital_map <- leaflet() %>%
  
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = -158.30,
    lat1 = 21.20,
    lng2 = -157.60,
    lat2 = 21.75) %>%

  addPolygons(
    data = oahu_area,
    color = "#ffffcc",
    weight = 1,
    fillColor = "#a1dab4",
    fillOpacity = 0.35,
    group = "Oahu study area") %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = isos_oahu,
    fillColor = ~pal(time),
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    color = "#ffffb2",
    weight = 0.7,
    label = ~paste("Within", time, "minutes from Chaminade"),
    group = "Driving time zones") %>%
  addPolylines(
    data = flood_lines,
    color = "#0077b6",
    weight = 2,
    opacity = 0.9,
    label = ~paste("Flood elevation:", elev, len_unit),
    popup = ~paste0(
      "Elevation: ", elev, " ", len_unit,
      "<br>Vertical datum: ", v_datum),
    group = "Flood elevation lines") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = hospitals,
    radius = 6,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    fillColor = "#253494",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    label = ~name,
    popup = ~popup,
    group = "Hospitals") %>%
  
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = pal(travel_times),
    labels = paste(travel_times, "minutes"),
    title = "Baseline driving time<br>from Chaminade") %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    colors = c("#253494", "#0077b6"),
    labels = c("Hospitals", "Flood elevation lines"),
    title = "Map features") %>%
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c(
      "Oahu study area",
      "Driving time zones",
      "Flood elevation lines",
      "Hospitals"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft")
```

```{r}
hospital_map
```
